inputs.original_text: A judge blocks a prolife law, and suddenly the story shifts from protecting unborn lives to institutions defending abortion in the name of religious freedom. The ACLU and Hoosier Jews for Choice supplied the argument, while the system’s framing makes that reversal seem principled and any limit seem oppressive. It doesn’t look like an accidental shift in emphasis; it looks like a coordinated effort to steer what people see as the real issue.
